messages:
Maria Chen: Canary run failed in eu-west1 at 09:12 UTC — GPU pressure spike, p95 RTT ~1.8s, p99 ~3.6s.
Tom Baker: grabbing pod logs from gpu-pool-2, seeing node restarts and a couple of kubelet evictions.
probe-bot: synthetic-canary: start check gpu-pressure-canary eu-west1 streaming-inference (id=cc-2034)
Kevin O'Neill: I can repro a reconnect storm locally if the probe reopens websockets too fast under CPU scheduling delays. Our current probe interval is 10s — that might amplify load during pressure.
Ajay Patel: Suggestion: switch to 30s interval and increase failures_before_alert to 3 for eu-west1 probe. Also add an embedding-sized payload to better emulate production (6k token-ish).
Maria Chen: Cost tradeoff: 30s interval vs 10s reduces probe egress and compute — rough estimate: ~$600/mo for eu-west1 probes alone. But alerting latency increases. Any objections?
Lina Gómez: Reminder on SLOs: hosted streaming has 99.5% <500ms, Dedicated customers expect tighter tail latencies (200ms). This canary should reflect Dedicated if targeting that fleet.
Tom Baker: Proposed blackbox config snippet to test in staging:
```yaml
blackbox_probe:
  name: gpu-pressure-canary
  targets:
    - url: wss://eu-west1-inference.redwood.ai/stream
      payload: { "type": "embed", "size": 6144 }
  interval: 30s
  failures_before_alert: 3
  timeout: 6s
  headers:
    x-canary: "true"
```
Kevin O'Neill: I'll add the job to Prometheus, and create a Grafana row. Alert rule proposal: page when failures >=4 OR (p99_rtt>2s AND failure_rate>0.05) for 5m. Also mute during node pool rolling upgrades.
Maria Chen: Also add panels for canary_probe_rtt_p95/p99, canary_success_rate, and canary_kv_cache_hit by region.
probe-bot: synthetic-canary: result: failed 2/5 checks (eu-west1) — reason: websocket closed 1006, associated node #5 rebooted during check
Ajay Patel: Tuning idea: only page for persistent issues — page if failures >=4 AND p99>2s AND node_restart_rate>0.1 over 5m. This reduces flapping from single-node reboots.
Maria Chen: Agreed. Add runbook link in alert annotation: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/canary-gpu-pressure. Include playbook steps: check node reboots, correlate with kube events, check streaming queue depth, fallback to model variant.
Kevin O'Neill: PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/compare/.../canary-gpu-tuning — will request review. :eyes:
